description:
The last hard surface before the map gives up. A weighbridge is set into the road here — two steel plates the width of a rig, worn bright by everything that has crossed them — and a booth beside it on a concrete plinth, with a board above that reads out in numbers a foot high. Somebody is always in the booth. There is nothing else out here for them to look at.

Past the plates the dirt runs south into a rust-stained plain hammered flat and hard, printed here and there with the tracks of things that crossed it once.
name: Ironpan Scale
